blocks.text: Cebu City, Philippines — The Visayas Grid has been placed again on yellow alert by the National Grid Corp. of the Philippines (NGCP) today, Nov. 19, from 5:00 p.m to 6:00 p.m. This is because the supply barely outpaces the power demand, leading to thin reserves or a very slim operating margin, which is not enough for the needed power contingency backup. As of 8:00 a.m., the Visayas grid’s available capacity is at 2,653 megawatts (MW) against a peak demand of 2,571 MW, leaving an operating margin of only 82 MW.
